item.title: IAS officer, booked for abusing, attacking cops at Bengaluru pub, transferred
item.description: Vikas Marmat, an IAS officer from Andhra Pradesh, has been transferred following an incident at a Bengaluru nightclub. This incident involved an inspection by the police to check for underage drinking. During the inspection, Marmat allegedly abused police officers after they requested age verification from women. He has been named the primary accused alongside three others who were also booked in the case.

item.title: Skidding bikes spark road safety debate over Kolkata flyover rainbow paint
item.description: A viral video has raised safety concerns after three motorcycles skidded on Chingrighata flyover. Authorities are investigating whether the festive road beautification compromised safety due to inappropriate surface coatings. Experts highlight that poorly applied paint can reduce tyre grip, especially when wet conditions occur. Senior officials indicated that steps will be taken based on expert recommendations regarding road surface materials.
item.dc:creator: KRISHNENDU BANDYOPADHYAY, SUMAN CHAKRABORTI, DWAIPAYAN GHOSH

item.title: Punjab Bandh after activist’s killing: Barricades on all roads to Mansa
item.description: In Mansa, police have intensified security and set up barricades following the tragic death of anti-drug advocate Parminder Singh Jhota. Activists erupted in protests, demanding a Punjab bandh on October 15. Commuters at Handiaya Chowk experienced significant delays as bus services were suspended, mirroring police responses to last month's suicide of Gulzar Singh linked to drug issues.
item.dc:creator: NEEL KAMAL

item.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella responds to Virat Kohli's first-ever LinkedIn post
item.description: Virat Kohli made his debut on LinkedIn, emphasizing his ambition to enhance Indian sports culture and brands. He announced his role as Investor in Agilitas and Co-founder of one8world. Kohli aims to create a comprehensive sports business model in India, involving manufacturing and distribution. Satya Nadella welcomed Kohli, recognizing the significance of this new chapter in his career. Kohli's vision reflects a commitment to building a lasting legacy in sports.

item.title: Texas judge overturns reservoir permit that could flood over 16,000 ranch acres
item.description: In a significant legal development, a Texas judge has scrapped the permit for the Lake Ringgold reservoir, amidst ongoing opposition from local ranchers concerned about environmental issues and property rights. Wichita Falls aims to appeal this ruling as they push for their water supply plans. This situation underscores the complex relationship between infrastructure advancements and conservation, with the city's next moves remaining unclear.

item.title: 2 killed, 6 injured after fire breaks out on 12th floor during Navratri event
item.description: On Tuesday night, a devastating fire broke out in the Imperial Heritage building located in Nalasopara East, resulting in the tragic loss of two women from smoke inhalation. Additionally, six other residents suffered injuries that required different levels of medical attention. The fire started on the 13th floor and left more than 25 people trapped, who were rescued by firefighters.
item.dc:creator: SUHAS BIRHADE

item.title: 'Let them prepare their jails': Dipke asks supporters to gather at CP, wave Tricolour
item.description: Founding member of the Cockroach Janta Party, Abhijit Dipke, has called on supporters to assemble at Central Park this Friday. He asserted that displaying the national flag is a fundamental right protected by the constitution, not a crime. Dipke has criticized the government’s response to dissent, likening it to an unofficial Emergency amid the unjust arrests of peaceful activists Saurabh Das and Ashutosh Ranka.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: New York townhouse hides subway ventilation shaft and emergency exit
item.description: Nestled at 58 Joralemon Street in Brooklyn Heights lies a historic brownstone that harbors a subway ventilation shaft beneath its surface. Established in 1847, it transformed into a vital transit hub in 1908 under the Brooklyn Rapid Transit Company. The building's unchanged facade allows it to integrate seamlessly into the neighborhood while fulfilling crucial safety roles.

item.title: Con Edison’s $300m Bronx substation disguised as rowhouses gets $47.3m upgrade
item.description: Con Edison is set to invest $47.3 million in enhancing the East 179th Street substation in the Bronx. This vital upgrade will include the installation of a fifth transformer and a new feeder line. The initiative aims to bolster the local electric capacity, facilitating support for electrification and electric vehicles.

item.title: US ends 540-day grace period for immigrants after work authorisation expires
item.description: In a significant policy shift, the US Department of Homeland Security is set to remove the 540-day work permit extension for immigrants, effective October 14. This change impacts various immigrant communities reliant on Employment Authorization Documents, as they will now only be able to renew their permits 180 days prior to their expiration date.

item.title: Pittsburgh plumber’s backyard observatory became prototype, led him to Einstein
item.description: Established in 1930 by Leo Scanlon, the Valley View Observatory in Pittsburgh quickly gained traction among amateur astronomers, primarily due to its cost-effective construction and unique aluminium dome. Scanlon's fresh approach drew attention from enthusiasts nationwide, leading to a memorable encounter with Albert Einstein in 1934, who appreciated the spirit of amateur science. To honor its significant role in astronomy, asteroid 8131 was named 'Scanlon', recognizing the observatory's legacy.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Lover hits woman on head, burns her body with room heater over marriage demand
item.description: A tragic incident unfolded as a 38-year-old woman fell victim to her lover, Javed Sheikh Shahid Manyar. The crime took place during her husband's absence, igniting a fierce argument over marriage. Javed's violent actions led to fatal burns, initially misunderstood by her family as an electric shock. Authorities apprehended him in Jalgaon, where he now remains in police custody following the shocking revelation of the truth.

item.title: ‘I’ve been in your shoes’: Ex-Netflix employee supports staff amid 1000 job cuts
item.description: Netflix recently announced layoffs affecting approximately 1,000 employees, which represents about six percent of its workforce. Former employee Omar Sealey reached out to provide support and encouragement to those affected. He emphasized that losing a job does not diminish an individual's talent or potential, which resonates with many facing uncertainty. Despite the layoffs, Netflix continues to generate significant profit, indicating challenges within the competitive streaming industry.

item.title: New Tata Curvv EV had a faulty charging port; buyer to get Rs 1.1 lakh and free repairs
item.description: A Hyderabad consumer commission found that a Tata Curvv electric car was delivered with a defective charging port. The buyer experienced repeated issues, leading to multiple unsuccessful repair attempts by the dealer. Legal action was taken against Tata Motors and its dealer for unresolved complaints and compensation claims. The commission ruled in favor of the buyer, ordering part replacements and compensation for mental anguish.
item.dc:creator: SAURABH THAKUR

item.title: 'Don't like going out anymore': Prithvi Shaw opens up on life, goal of India comeback
item.description: At 26, Prithvi Shaw is focused on rebuilding his cricket career after years of setbacks, criticism and limited international opportunities. He is prioritising cricket, family and discipline while avoiding public attention. Despite being dropped by Mumbai and missing IPL 2025, Shaw has regained form in domestic cricket. His ultimate ambition remains returning to India’s national team through consistent performances.

item.title: 'It was suicide, not murder': Model breaks silence in UP bizman's death case
item.description: Shraddha Dubey posted a video denying involvement in the death of restaurant owner Shiva Sharma. She claims that Sharma's death resulted from suicide rather than murder. Dubey expressed her willingness to cooperate with police and deny absconding. Sharma's mother accused Dubey and others of murder following Sharma's fall from the apartment. Investigators are currently examining the allegations while Dubey plans to provide her statement to the authorities.

item.title: Pragyan Ojha may continue as interim chief selector
item.description: Parthiv Patel's decision to opt out has given rise to speculation that the head of the BCCI’s Centre of Excellence (CoE), VVS Laxman, may have a greater say in selection affairs, with Pragyan Ojha continuing as the interim chairman of the selection committee. With the ODI World Cup less than a year away, will the BCCI choose to continue with the two?

item.title: Oil prices fall $1 after touching three week high amid Middle East tensions
item.description: Oil prices have dipped as investors assess potential shipping threats in the Strait of Hormuz. The uptick in prices was initially fueled by recent assaults on Saudi Aramco and provocations from Iran. The Trump administration is mulling over the possibility of loosening sanctions on oil vessels to alleviate shipping costs, particularly given the surge in freight prices.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: 'Got to look at luggage weight': Hope jokes after another POTM award in India
item.description: West Indies captain Shai Hope praised his team’s performance after scoring an unbeaten 102 off 50 balls against India in the fourth T20I. He said 247 was a competitive total, as the pitch proved challenging. West Indies won by 24 runs, levelling the series 2-2. Hope has enjoyed an outstanding India tour, scoring four centuries across formats.
item.dc:creator: JYOTIRMOY HALDER

item.title: When will Team India's ODI squad for New Zealand tour be picked? Details inside
item.description: The Pragyan Ojha-led selection committee has already picked India’s T20I squad for the five-match T20I series in New Zealand, which will start from Oct 22. The five-match ODI series will start on Nov 4 in Auckland. It's understood that Ojha met Team India captain Shubman Gill and head coach Gautam Gambhir, celebrating his 45th birthday, in Hyderabad on Wednesday, for the first time since the BCCI asked him to take over as the interim chairman of the national selection committee.
item.dc:creator: GAURAV GUPTA

item.title: Will work to strengthen BJP: Odisha governor-designate
item.description: Controversy brews in Odisha following Braj Mohan Ram's remarks aimed at enhancing the BJP's foothold after assuming the governorship. Opposition figures from BJD and Congress have criticized his stance, expressing concerns over the expected neutrality associated with the governor's position. Meanwhile, the BJP has rallied to support Ram, claiming the opposition is merely inflating tensions. This development invites scrutiny about the intersection of political agendas and constitutional responsibilities.
